description: s441 round 4 (review round 3, finding 3). A handler that awaits a server call then uses the event a control property write (`event.cancelBubble = true`). By then the browser has already acted on the event, so the control has no effect (the form submits). Rounds 2-3 matched call shapes and each shape was bypassed; round 4 POISONS the event binding after the first await: any use of the event, or of anything derived from it, other than a plain read of a non-control property is E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT.
rationale: §13.2: after a handler's first await, only plain reads of non-control event properties are allowed; every other use of the event or a value derived from it SHALL be E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT (§34).
